statement: The wireless IBEX probe only registers native controller devices when the connection status says connected. A queued transition calls registration when connected and without an open raw client. Registration creates a new input gamepad, motion-sensor input device and a best-effort battery power supply for the associated HID interface.

applicability.revision: pinned Linux v7.3-rc1 and SDL 6defbc0 consumer source; retail hardware unmeasured
applicability.scope: Steam Controller 2026 Puck receiver consumer behavior; no physical or virtual host test
